figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 470" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>How an Annubar flow meter converts differential pressure to flow</title>
<rect width="800" height="470" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How an Annubar Measures Flow</text>
<rect x="20" y="70" width="230" height="100" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="135.0" y="102.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Insertion</text>
<text x="135.0" y="126.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">bar spans the pipe</text>
<text x="135.0" y="150.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and disturbs flow</text>
<line x1="252" y1="120" x2="283" y2="120" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="285" y="70" width="230" height="100" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="102.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. High side</text>
<text x="400.0" y="126.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">upstream taps sense</text>
<text x="400.0" y="150.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">static + dynamic</text>
<line x1="517" y1="120" x2="548" y2="120" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="550" y="70" width="230" height="100" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="665.0" y="102.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Low side</text>
<text x="665.0" y="126.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">downstream tap</text>
<text x="665.0" y="150.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">senses static pressure</text>
<rect x="20" y="230" width="230" height="100" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="135.0" y="262.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6. DCS or PLC</text>
<text x="135.0" y="286.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">square root extraction</text>
<text x="135.0" y="310.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Q = K × √ΔP</text>
<line x1="283" y1="280" x2="252" y2="280" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="285" y="230" width="230" height="100" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="262.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5. DP transmitter</text>
<text x="400.0" y="286.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">secondary device</text>
<text x="400.0" y="310.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">reads ΔP</text>
<line x1="548" y1="280" x2="517" y2="280" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="550" y="230" width="230" height="100" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="665.0" y="262.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Form ΔP</text>
<text x="665.0" y="286.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ΔP = High − Low</text>
<text x="665.0" y="310.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">rises as velocity²</text>
<line x1="665" y1="172" x2="665" y2="228" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="135" y1="332" x2="135" y2="368" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="20" y="370" width="230" height="56" rx="10" fill="#0d9488" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="135.0" y="405.0" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Flow rate</text>
<text x="520" y="392" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Annubar creates ΔP, transmitter</text>
<text x="520" y="418" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">measures it, logic converts it to flow</text>
</svg>
